statement: At the pinned revisions, the Linux Nintendo Switch 2 HID path rejects non-USB devices and has only USB match entries for Joy-Con 2; the SDL Switch 2 HIDAPI initializer explicitly rejects Bluetooth. Therefore Bluetooth-bus UHID is not an established recognition path for these consumers at these pins. Actual retail Bluetooth framing and pairing remain unknown.

applicability.scope: Linux and SDL source-level Bluetooth support limit
